Privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy and personal data protection for Laure Corrao.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: Laure Corrao, a psychopractitioner and couples therapist, is responsible for the processing described here. She has not appointed a data protection officer.

sections.title: Data collected and how it is used
paragraphs: Contact and free introductory conversation. The form asks for your first and last names, telephone number, email address and message. The subject of your request and booking details, including the time you choose, help Laure respond and arrange the free 10-minute conversation. These steps are taken at your request before a contract is made. The form cannot be submitted without the required fields.
Support. If you decide to continue, the identity, contact and administrative details needed to organise your sessions are processed to perform the contract.
Quotes and payments. Quotes, billing details, amounts and payment status are used to administer the contract and meet accounting obligations. The quote and payment link are sent by email.
Site security. The host may retain connection logs, including IP addresses, to protect the site and prevent abuse. The legal basis is the legitimate interest in keeping the service secure.

sections.title: Sensitive information
paragraphs: A general description of your request is sufficient. Please do not include diagnoses, detailed accounts of trauma or other sensitive information in the public form, calendar or payment reference.
Processing health data requires a legal basis and a specific condition under Article 9 of the GDPR. Accepting the terms of sale does not constitute explicit consent to such processing.

sections.title: Recipients and service providers
paragraphs: Authorised individuals access only the data necessary for their tasks. Hostinger hosts the website. The contact form sends requests to #1344 Solutions through its Forge service. Cal.com processes booking details for the free introductory conversation.
Data may be shared with authorities where legally required. Data is not sold to third parties.

sections.title: Retention periods
paragraphs: Contact requests that do not lead to a service are kept for one year, then deleted or anonymised. For data entered in the calendar, see also Cal.com’s privacy policy.

Invoices and supporting accounting documents subject to the retention requirement are kept for ten years from the close of the relevant financial year. Other data is kept for as long as necessary for its purpose. Archived records may only be accessed for the purposes that justify keeping them.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Technical and organisational measures protect data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration and disclosure. The contact form and public calendar are intended for practical arrangements.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on the processing and applicable conditions, you can request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability, or object to certain processing. Where consent is the legal basis, you can withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Use the site’s contact form or write to the practice address above. Proof of identity is requested only where there is reasonable doubt about your identity. Requests are normally answered within one month. Any justified extension will be explained. You can also lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority (CNIL).

links.label: Lodge a complaint with the CNIL

sections.title: Cookies and external services
paragraphs: The site does not directly install advertising or audience measurement trackers. Displaying the calendar connects to Cal.com, which may use cookies necessary for booking.

Strictly necessary trackers can be used without consent where the legal conditions are met. Optional trackers requiring consent need your prior agreement. Refusing must be as easy as accepting. You can also restrict cookies in your browser.

sections.title: Updates
paragraphs: This policy is updated when practices or services change. If changes require specific notice or fresh consent, the corresponding steps will be taken.

Terms.metaDescription: Individual, couples and family consultations and support
Terms.subtitle: Individual, couples and family consultations and support

sections.title: Identification and scope
paragraphs: These terms govern the individual, couples and family support services Laure Corrao offers to consumers on laurecorrao.fr. Her practice address is Les Jardins de Louis, 9 impasse Le Maroni — Saint-Jean, 13110 Port-de-Bouc, France. Telephone: +33 6 69 31 64 50.
The terms are sent with the quote before the client commits. The accepted version applies to that contract.

sections.title: Nature of the support
paragraphs: Laure Corrao offers individual, couples and family support, drawing on conversation, a systemic approach and tools for managing emotions. The quote specifies the service appropriate to the request.

She undertakes to use the agreed professional means without guaranteeing a particular outcome. This support does not replace medical or psychiatric care and does not include medical diagnosis or prescriptions. She may suggest another professional where appropriate.

sections.title: Free introductory conversation
paragraphs: The free, 10-minute conversation gives both parties an opportunity to discuss the request and assess whether the proposed support is suitable. It is not a therapy session and carries no obligation to book a paid consultation.

sections.title: Quote and booking
paragraphs: If both parties wish to continue, they agree on a time. Laure emails a personalised quote specifying the service, duration, final price, date, location or remote format, payment terms and validity period.

The terms and, where applicable, a withdrawal form accompany the quote. The contract is formed upon express acceptance of the quote and terms. Confirmation and contractual documents are sent by email.
Where payment on arrival is agreed, advance online payment is not required to confirm the appointment.

sections.title: Fees
paragraphs: Individual session: €60 for one hour. Couples session: €90 for 90 minutes for the whole session. Family session: €90 for 90 minutes for the whole session.
No additional fees may be charged without prior information and agreement. Price changes do not affect accepted quotes.

sections.title: Payment
paragraphs: The payment method is agreed when arranging the appointment. Payment can be made online before the session using a secure link sent by email, or on arrival at the practice, including in cash within legal limits.
A receipt or invoice is issued as required, regardless of the payment method.

sections.title: Cancellation, rescheduling and refunds
paragraphs: Please request cancellations or changes at least 48 hours before the appointment by telephone or text on +33 6 69 31 64 50.
When this notice is given, any sums paid for the cancelled session are refunded within 14 days or transferred to a rescheduled session with the client’s agreement.

If Laure cancels, she offers an alternative that the client may decline. Payments for a session that does not take place are then refunded within 14 days of cancellation. The statutory rules on force majeure apply. These provisions do not limit any statutory right of withdrawal.

sections.title: Right of withdrawal
paragraphs: For distance service contracts covered by the French Consumer Code, the client has 14 days from conclusion of the contract to withdraw without giving a reason. The client may send the form below or an unambiguous statement to the practice address.
Sums concerned are refunded within 14 days of notification using the same payment method, unless the client expressly agrees to another method at no cost.

If a session is requested before the 14 days expire, the express request to start early is recorded on a durable medium. If the client withdraws after work has begun at their express request, a proportionate amount may be due for services actually provided if the required information was given.

The right is lost after full performance before the deadline only if performance began with the client’s prior express consent and acknowledgement that full performance would end this right. Payment or booking alone does not constitute consent.
Where necessary, the following statements are obtained separately, without preselected boxes:
“I expressly request that the service begin before the 14-day withdrawal period ends.”
“I acknowledge that I will lose my right to withdraw once the service has been fully performed.”

sections.title: Withdrawal form
paragraphs: To Laure Corrao, Les Jardins de Louis, 9 impasse Le Maroni — Saint-Jean, 13110 Port-de-Bouc, France.
I hereby withdraw from the contract for the following service: ____________________

sections.title: Sessions and confidentiality
paragraphs: Sessions take place in an atmosphere of mutual respect. Information shared is kept confidential, subject to legal obligations and exceptions. The arrangements for couples and family sessions, including any individual conversations, are explained before support begins.
No recording takes place without prior information and agreement from those concerned.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: The practitioner’s liability is assessed under the ordinary rules of law. These terms do not remove mandatory consumer rights.

sections.title: Complaints and mediation
paragraphs: Complaints may be sent in writing to the practice address above. After an unresolved written complaint, consumers may seek free mediation subject to the statutory admissibility conditions, including the one-year period following the written complaint. Mediation does not remove the right to take legal action.

sections.title: Personal data and applicable law
paragraphs: French law applies, subject to mandatory consumer protections. If the dispute cannot be settled amicably, the competent courts are determined under the applicable legal rules.

HomePage.aboutTitle: What if you finally gave yourself room to feel better?
HomePage.aboutBody: I am Laure Corrao, psychopractitioner and couples therapist. I accompany you with kindness, listening, and without judgment, in a confidential space where you can set things down fully, at your own pace.
HomePage.quote: You do not need to know where to start. You only need to dare to take the first step.
HomePage.readingLead: Feelings can become overwhelming, fears can take over, or the same patterns can close in. Anxiety, phobias, a lack of confidence, emotional wounds, relationship difficulties, or a crisis in the couple: you do not have to go through this alone.
HomePage.readingBody: My approach is personal and draws on several therapeutic tools, including hypnosis, cognitive and behavioural therapies, the systemic approach, and coaching. Because every person, every story, and every couple is unique, the support is unique too.
HomePage.placeTitle: A place to find yourself again.
HomePage.placeBody: In the warm, calming atmosphere of my practice, you can finally put words to what hurts, understand more of what is happening for you, and move toward a calmer balance.
HomePage.practiceBody: A warm, confidential, and non-judgmental setting. Practical directions will be confirmed before you come.
HomePage.videoBody: Settle somewhere quiet, where you can speak in confidence.
HomePage.placeClose: Here, you do not need to know where to start. You only need to dare to take the first step.

Individual.journeyAlt: A watercolour path illustrates a personal journey: name what weighs on you, discuss it at a first appointment, understand yourself better and move at your own pace towards greater calm and independence.
Individual.metaDescription: A place to understand what you are going through and find your own resources.
Individual.lede: A place to understand what you are going through and find your own resources.
before: Some periods of life leave us fragile, unsteady, or feeling unable to move forward alone. Individual support offers a confidential, kind, and non-judgmental space where you can set down what you feel.
Individual.listIntro: I accompany you in particular with:
items: anxiety, panic, and phobias;
a loss of self-esteem or self-confidence;
emotional wounds and the consequences of traumatic experiences;
emotional dependence and relationship difficulties;
separations, grief, and times of transition;
blocks, repeating patterns, and difficulty setting limits;
stress, emotional overload, or the sense of no longer finding your place.
after: The first sessions are there to understand your story, your current difficulties, and what you want to see change. Together we then define support suited to your needs and your pace.
The aim is not to impose a direction, but to help you understand more of what is happening for you, ease what hurts, and gradually trust your own capacities again.
You do not need to know where to start. The first appointment is there for that.

Couple.imageAlt: A couple sitting on a sofa talks with a therapist holding a notebook.
Couple.metaDescription: A place to talk again when the relationship can no longer move forward on its own.
Couple.lede: A place to talk again when the relationship can no longer move forward on its own.
before: Over time, a couple can meet misunderstandings, repeated conflict, emotional distance, or a break in trust. Each person tries to be heard, and the exchanges can become painful or impossible.
Couples therapy offers a neutral, confidential, and safe frame in which each partner can express their experience, expectations, frustrations, and needs.
Couple.listIntro: I accompany you in particular when you are facing:
items: communication difficulties;
repeating arguments or conflicts that stay unresolved;
emotional, affectionate, or intimate distance;
a loss of trust or an infidelity;
a crisis, a separation you are considering, or one already underway;
disagreements about family, children, or life plans;
difficulty rebuilding the bond after a trial.
after: The sessions help identify the relational patterns that keep the tension going, understand each person’s place and needs, and create new ways of communicating.

I am neither judge nor referee. My role is to help each partner be heard, while helping the couple find a calmer dialogue. Depending on your situation, the work may aim to rebuild the bond, find a new balance, or separate more consciously and respectfully.
Every couple has its own story. The sessions and the tools offered are therefore shaped around your situation, your expectations, and your pace.
Asking for help does not mean your couple has failed. It means you choose not to stay alone with the difficulty.

Approach.metaDescription: Therapy shaped around you, because every person and every story is unique.
Approach.lede: Therapy shaped around you, because every person and every story is unique.
before: I do not believe in the same support for everyone. A method can suit one person and miss what another needs. That is why I build each accompaniment around your story, your personality, your difficulties, and your aims.
Approach.listIntro: My approach is integrative: it joins listening and speech with the therapeutic tools I am trained in, including:
items: cognitive and behavioural therapies, to identify and shift certain thoughts, emotions, and reactions;
the systemic approach, particularly suited to understanding relationships, couples, and family patterns;
the psychoanalytic approach and talk therapy, to explore your story and understand the origin of certain patterns;
hypnosis, to work on certain blocks, fears, or automatic responses;
art therapy, so expression can happen other than through words when that is useful;
neurolinguistic programming (NLP), and coaching tools for accompanying change.
after: These tools are never applied mechanically. I choose the ones that match your needs, and I always explain what I am proposing. You remain free, and fully part of the work.
The first sessions are given to listening to your request, understanding your situation, and defining your aims. The work then evolves with you, respecting your pace and your limits.
My practice is meant as a warm, confidential, and non-judgmental place: somewhere you can put words to what hurts, feel listened to, and move forward safely.
You do not have to wait until things get worse to start taking care of yourself.

dtma.title: DTMA — Support after trauma and difficult life events
dtma.subtitle: Guided eye movements and alternating taps
dtma.body: Sexual violence, a car accident, bereavement or a sudden separation can leave lasting distress. In my practice, DTMA uses guided eye movements and alternating taps to explore emotions associated with painful memories. We begin by discussing your needs so that we can work at your pace. Severe trauma may require specialist care alongside this support or as a first priority.
dtma.alt: A woman follows the raised fingers of the practitioner seated opposite her with her eyes.

overview.title: ADHD: understanding yourself and finding your bearings
overview.intro: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder can make everyday situations particularly demanding. Concentrating, getting organised, waiting or finishing a task can take a great deal of effort.
overview.body: I offer support tailored to your age and needs so you can understand these difficulties, recognise your strengths and find practical solutions.
overview.alt: Illustration showing four aspects of ADHD: attention, organisation, time management and impulsivity.

child.title: Children: growing up with guidance and confidence
child.intro: Does your child forget instructions, get distracted or act before thinking? Are homework and daily routines becoming a source of tension?
child.body: Through conversation and age-appropriate play, I help your child understand how they work, express their feelings and take things one step at a time. We work together to find routines that help at home and recognise your child’s progress.
child.goal: The aim is to support your child and help your family find a calmer daily rhythm.
child.alt: A child stacks wooden blocks to build a tower.

teen.title: Teenagers: understanding yourself and becoming more independent
teen.intro: Homework piles up, getting organised becomes harder, and repeated criticism can wear away at a teenager’s confidence.
teen.body: I offer your teenager a space to be heard without judgement and to take part in decisions that affect them. Together we look for strategies that fit their life, from starting a task and managing time to taking helpful breaks and explaining what they need.
teen.goal: The aim is to help your teenager build independence by drawing on their strengths.
teen.alt: A teenager writes in a notebook beside open books.

adult.title: Adults: easing everyday pressures and rebuilding confidence
adult.intro: Do you feel you are always racing against the clock, starting things you struggle to finish or wearing yourself out trying to manage everything?
adult.body: I help you identify difficult situations and try practical tools, such as clarifying priorities, breaking tasks into steps, setting reminders and recognising your limits.
adult.goal: The aim is to find ways of organising your life that suit you and help you feel less self-critical.
adult.alt: A woman at her desk wonders which task to start with.

first.title: A first conversation to take stock
first.body: In our first session we explore what brings you here, what feels difficult and what you would like to change. We then agree on realistic goals at your pace.
first.scope: My support complements any care you need and does not provide a diagnosis. If you think you may have ADHD, I encourage you to speak to a doctor trained in diagnosing it.

Parenting.h1: Less tension, more conversation at home
Parenting.metaDescription: Parenting coaching in Port-de-Bouc with Laure Corrao to help you communicate, set clear boundaries and ease family tensions.
Parenting.intro: Do you find yourself repeating the same instructions, only for the conversation to end in an argument? Screen time, homework, boundaries, disagreements about parenting… Do you sometimes feel overwhelmed and unsure how to respond?
Parenting.support: I help you understand what is happening and find solutions that work for your family.
Parenting.space: There’s room to step back and reflect without feeling judged for the way you parent.
Parenting.practice: Together we work on everyday situations, from setting clear limits and communicating better to supporting your children through difficult emotions and building routines that make daily life easier.
Parenting.sessions: You can attend on your own or with your child’s other parent. Together we decide whether it would help to involve your children.
Parenting.goal: The aim is to help you regain confidence as a parent and build calmer family relationships, one step at a time.
Parenting.reassurance: You can reach out for support before you feel at the end of your tether.
Parenting.alt: A girl speaks during a family card game.
